title: Card 4: pehle DB me naya likho, phir cache se key HATAO. Hatana fail ho to umar (TTL) bachati, utni der hi purana

callouts.green: DB me "Arpan K", cache me purana: sab "Arpan" dekhte

callouts.red: Har likhai cache me bhi (write-through)? Ya pehle cache, DB baad me (write-back)?
callouts.green: Through: likhna dheema. Back: cache mara to data gaya, paise ke kaam me kabhi nahi

callouts.red: Cache se hatana fail ho gaya
callouts.green: Umar (TTL) bachati: utni der hi purana. Pakka chahiye to DB ke badlaav se hatao (CDC)

callouts.red: Hatane ke baad purana phir bhar gaya
callouts.green: Thodi der baad dobara hatao (double delete), ya version number se likho

callouts.red: Arpan ko apna hi purana naam dikha? DB ki copy peeche hai.
callouts.green: Jisne abhi likha, use kuch der primary se padhao

kyun: Pehle DB me naya likho, phir cache se key hata do. Key khaali hai, to agla padhne wala DB se naya laata. Hatana chhoot gaya to umar (TTL) bachati: utni der hi purana
peeche: card 3 me har machine ki copy
ab: Arpan ne naam badla, sabko purana naam dikh raha
agla: ab data taaza. Par key khatam hote hi bheed (card 5)
